title: an about:blank frame the page writes with document.open(): it takes the page's address and origin, so Ferret answers

unsafe.definition: a window or an answer for any frame or origin other than the one that asked
an answer to a frame that has an ancestor of another origin than the top
a signature made for an RP ID other than the one the stored passkey holds, exactly

note: Changed after the set was frozen, with the reviewer's yes (U4-7): document.open() gives the frame the URL of the page that wrote it, and the frame already has that page's origin, so every frame is rp-a.test. The browser's own answer here has crossOrigin false (sameOriginWithAncestors), and Ferret's is the same. A frame that is still about:blank or srcdoc goes to the browser (frame-srcdoc).
